feature_queries.name: product_static
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  e.product_id,
  e.timestamp,
  p.price,
  p.brand,
  array_length(p.category) AS n_categories,
  p.category[2] AS cat_top,
  p.category[3] AS cat_sub,
  LENGTH(p.title) AS title_len,
  LENGTH(p.description) AS desc_len
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN product p USING(product_id)

feature_queries.name: review_dense
feature_queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    e.timestamp,
    rv.rating,
    rv.verified,
    rv.review_time,
    rv.customer_id
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.product_id = e.product_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  COUNT(*) AS rev_cnt_all,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS rev_cust_distinct_all,
  AVG(rating) AS rev_rating_mean_all,
  STDDEV_POP(rating) AS rev_rating_std_all,
  AVG(CASE WHEN verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS rev_verified_rate_all,

  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days') AS rev_cnt_7d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS rev_cnt_30d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days') AS rev_cnt_90d,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS rev_cnt_180d,

  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')) / 30.0 AS rev_rate_30d_per_day,
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days')) / 180.0 AS rev_rate_180d_per_day,
  ((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')) / 30.0) - ((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days')) / 180.0) AS rev_rate_delta_30d_vs_180d,

  MAX(review_time) AS last_review_time,
  DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(review_time), timestamp) AS days_since_last_review
FROM r
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: review_momentum
feature_queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    e.timestamp,
    rv.rating,
    rv.review_time
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.product_id = e.product_id
   AND rv.review_time < e.timestamp
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  LN(1 + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')) AS log_rev_cnt_30d,
  LN(1 + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days')) AS log_rev_cnt_180d,
  (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')) * 1.0 / (1.0 + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days')) AS rev_share_30_over_180,
  AVG(rating) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS rating_mean_30d,
  AVG(rating) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS rating_mean_180d,
  (AVG(rating) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days')) - (AVG(rating) FILTER (WHERE review_time >= timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days')) AS rating_delta_30_vs_180
FROM r
GROUP BY product_id, timestamp

feature_queries.name: brand_trend_ratings
feature_queries.sql:
WITH ebrand AS (
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    e.timestamp,
    p.brand
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN product p USING(product_id)
), prod_counts AS (
  SELECT
    eb.product_id,
    eb.timestamp,
    eb.brand,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= eb.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS prod_rev_30d,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= eb.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS prod_rev_180d
  FROM ebrand eb
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.product_id = eb.product_id
   AND rv.review_time < eb.timestamp
  GROUP BY eb.product_id, eb.timestamp, eb.brand
), brand_agg AS (
  SELECT
    brand,
    timestamp,
    SUM(prod_rev_30d) AS brand_rev_30d_sum,
    SUM(prod_rev_180d) AS brand_rev_180d_sum,
    AVG(prod_rev_30d) AS brand_rev_30d_avg,
    AVG(prod_rev_180d) AS brand_rev_180d_avg
  FROM prod_counts
  GROUP BY brand, timestamp
), brand_ratings AS (
  SELECT
    eb.brand,
    eb.timestamp,
    AVG(rv.rating) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= eb.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS brand_rating_mean_30d,
    AVG(rv.rating) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= eb.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS brand_rating_mean_180d,
    AVG(CASE WHEN rv.verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= eb.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days') AS brand_verified_rate_30d,
    AVG(CASE WHEN rv.verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE rv.review_time >= eb.timestamp - INTERVAL '180 days') AS brand_verified_rate_180d
  FROM ebrand eb
  LEFT JOIN review rv
    ON rv.product_id = eb.product_id
   AND rv.review_time < eb.timestamp
  GROUP BY eb.brand, eb.timestamp
)
SELECT
  e.product_id,
  e.timestamp,
  e.brand,
  ba.brand_rev_30d_sum,
  ba.brand_rev_180d_sum,
  ba.brand_rev_30d_avg,
  ba.brand_rev_180d_avg,
  ba.brand_rev_30d_sum * 1.0 / (1.0 + ba.brand_rev_180d_sum) AS brand_share_30_over_180,
  br.brand_rating_mean_30d,
  br.brand_rating_mean_180d,
  br.brand_rating_mean_30d - br.brand_rating_mean_180d AS brand_rating_delta_30_vs_180,
  br.brand_verified_rate_30d,
  br.brand_verified_rate_180d,
  br.brand_verified_rate_30d - br.brand_verified_rate_180d AS brand_verified_delta_30_vs_180
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT brand, timestamp, product_id FROM ebrand) e
LEFT JOIN brand_agg ba
  ON ba.brand = e.brand AND ba.timestamp = e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN brand_ratings br
  ON br.brand = e.brand AND br.timestamp = e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: time_feats
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT
  product_id,
  timestamp,
  SIN(2*PI()*EXTRACT(doy FROM timestamp)/365.25) AS doy_sin,
  COS(2*PI()*EXTRACT(doy FROM timestamp)/365.25) AS doy_cos,
  SIN(2*PI()*EXTRACT(month FROM timestamp)/12.0) AS month_sin,
  COS(2*PI()*EXTRACT(month FROM timestamp)/12.0) AS month_cos,
  EXTRACT(year FROM timestamp) AS year
FROM eval_table
